title: POSEIDON: Scaling Training Environments for Scientific Agents from Code Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2610.32448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training environments remain a major bottleneck for agents in data-driven scientific discovery. Existing collections of executable and verifiable training environments are small, and their construction remains difficult to scale. To address this limitation, we introduce Poseidon, an automated pipeline for generating diverse, verifiable training environments from scientific code repositories at scale. From the same repository budget, Poseidon extracts nearly 10 times as many training environments as a prior approach by decomposing scientific workflows into four complementary task types: Reproduction, Subflow, Completion, and Correction, where each type targets a distinct capability for scientific research. A recursive improvement loop further refines failed candidates and recovers otherwise discarded environments. translated_title: POSEIDON：从代码仓库为科学智能体规模化构建训练环境
translated_abstract: 训练环境仍然是数据驱动科学发现中智能体面临的主要瓶颈。现有的可执行、可验证训练环境集合规模较小，且其构建难以规模化。为解决这一局限，我们提出了Poseidon——一个从科学代码仓库中大规模自动生成多样化、可验证训练环境的自动化流水线。在相同的仓库预算下，Poseidon通过将科学工作流分解为四种互补的任务类型（复现、子流程、补全和修正）提取出近10倍于先前方法的训练环境，其中每种类型都针对科学研究的一项独特能力。递归改进循环进一步优化失败的候选环境，并回收原本会被丢弃的环境。利用Poseidon，我们构建了Pearl——一个包含来自7,110个公开仓库的97,659个可执行且可验证环境的集合。
tldr: POSEIDON通过将科学工作流分解为复现、子流程、补全和修正四类任务并配合递归改进循环，实现了从科学代码仓库自动规模化生成可执行可验证的训练环境，构建了包含97,659个环境的Pearl数据集，环境数量约为先前方法的10倍。
en_tdlr: POSEIDON automatically scales the generation of executable and verifiable training environments from scientific code repositories by decomposing scientific workflows into four complementary task types with a recursive improvement loop, yielding Pearl—a collection of 97,659 environments, nearly 10 times more than prior approaches.
